content: Homebrew official manpage documents brew list options for formulae/casks/full-name and brew tab --installed-on-request / --no-installed-on-request, which controls whether installed formulae or casks are marked as requested and therefore protected from autoremove. Phase 2 should use installed formula listing plus installed-on-request listing to classify formulae as direct or dependency, and should treat request classification as unknown if the request-list command fails while the installed list succeeds.
